messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — where are we on onboarding Kestrel-3B into the model catalog? Need licensing, perf profile, and canary plan to go green for launch.

Kevin Ortiz: Perf looks good on CPU fallback but GPU q8_0 has a regression at long sequences. p50=95ms p95=280ms on test harness. PR with perf tweaks is up: #4523

Carl Nguyen: PR #4523 includes attention kernel fallback; still seeing tokenization mismatch on some inputs. Filed issue #789.

Sophia Patel: Legal check: Kestrel weights are Apache-2.0, but has third-party subcomponent with CC-BY-4.0 samples. We need TOC for training data provenance. Flagging for compliance sign-off.

Maya Chen: @Sophia can you confirm whether CC-BY-4.0 blocks listing or just requires attribution? Product needs to know for public catalog.

Sophia Patel: CC-BY requires attribution. Not a legal blocker, but we need to include an attribution field in the model metadata and doc link to source data.

Anna Roberts: Product note: we'll add an "attribution" UI field. Can we get final text by EOD so design can ship the tile copy?

Kevin Ortiz: Perf note: here's a quick benchmark snippet I ran:
```
./bench --model=kestrel-3b --seq=1024 --batch=4
p50: 95ms
p95: 280ms
tokens/s: 420
```
I'll run another with q4f16 tomorrow.

Ryan Gomez: Infra canary: I can schedule a 2-hour canary tomorrow 02:00-04:00 UTC on dedicated pool. We need a traffic split and rollback tag. Suggested policy: 5% traffic, 30m ramp, auto-failover to rna-3b.

Maya Chen: Sounds good. @deploy-bot can you create canary job with tag kestrel-3b-canary-2026-03-18?

deploy-bot: Canary job kestrel-3b-canary-2026-03-18 created. CI required status: pass. :white_check_mark:

Carl Nguyen: Tokenizer PR merged. Needs QA run — @kevin can you re-run perf tests after merged changes?

Kevin Ortiz: On it, will post results in this thread.

Sophia Patel: I'll prepare a short attribution blurb and upload to the model metadata doc.

Anna Roberts: If legal blurb ready EOD and perf verifies after kernel fixes, product can flip the catalog switch early next week.

Maya Chen: Action items: Kevin re-run perf + post numbers (due tomorrow), Sophia upload attribution (EOD), Ryan schedule canary (done), Carl confirm QA pass (ASAP). Thanks team :rocket:

Kevin Ortiz: Perf re-run done — p50=92ms p95=260ms tokens/s=450 after tokenizer fix. No regression in q4f16 baseline. Posting logs: https://redwood.internal/blah/logs/171805

Carl Nguyen: QA pass ✅ bumped to canary image tag kestrel-3b:v20260318

Maya Chen: Closing this sync — will open a launch checklist PR and assign owners. Ping me directly for blockers. :thumbsup:
